required_changes: RC1 reference noise from repeat traversals on different days; third R2 outcome not testable when the floor at L=500 m is above about 1 pp
RC2 split P2a (DEM on OBD track) and P2b (DEM on matched cloud route); segments by projected position; R2 on P2b
RC3 G0 checks the R2 support floor (30 days, 100 km) before any download request
RC4 report grade SD and prevalence; error criteria primary; bias interval inside +-1.0 pp
RC5 R5 comparator: validation segments versus all matched cloud routes
RC6 no grade-sensitive cell = not established with MDE, not falsified; multiplicity and M441 floors after downhill exclusion
RC7 public repo: no per-drive coordinates committed; aggregates only; record sha256, version and licence of downloads

answers.a: agreement design between two proxies; stratify on the mean of the two grades
answers.b: yes for (a)/(b) at L=500 m; tag bridges, cuttings and urban (surface model)
answers.c: grade-class stratification primary; m g dh sensitivity only
answers.d: labelled sensitivity only; never counts toward R2 or G3

risks: DEM error mislabelled as reference error or the reverse
repeated commute roads inflate n (report unique km)
reverse movement read as regen events
